programs.showName: [LIVE] VALORANT Champions Tour South Asia Kickoff Playoffs : Day 2
programs.description:
Welcome to the official broadcast of VALORANT Champions Tour South Asia 🏆

This is the grand stage for South Asia’s top VALORANT teams ready to compete and Make their Mark. Only the best squads will emerge victorious and secure their shot at the 2027 VCT LCQ 🔥

📅 Today's Match Schedule:

🕒 Match 1 - 3:00 PM | Revenant XSpark vs. GOC Esports [Bo3]
🕕 Match 2 - 6:00 PM| Kryon Esports vs. Rankers [Bo3]

💥 Participating Teams:
⚔ Godlike Esports
⚔ Trigger Point Esports
⚔ Zexar Esports
⚔ Sign Esports
⚔ Revenant XSpark
⚔ GOC Esports
⚔ Kryon Esports
⚔ Rankers

Which team are you cheering for? Drop your predictions in the comments! 👇
